title: top-up: workflow-sync template actions for the Actions allow-list
definition: Reviewed the workflow-sync template action references (Issue #4448). The module adapts gh to the command runner the language detector and workflow auditor take: only gh is run, any other command is refused, and a thrown gh error becomes a failed command carrying its message. It detects the repository's languages, audits its workflows, and collects the uses: references of the missing and partial workflow-sync templates, sorted and unique, skipping local paths and docker:// references and keeping GitHub-owned actions. The function never throws; a failed detection, audit or read is reported as a fault with references left empty, never a partial list. Repository text is parsed as data only, and nothing from it is executed.
